import json, os, re, urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
AGENT = "+15095611012"

def call(path, method="GET", payload=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai" + path, data=data, method=method, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:150]

status, listing = call("/v1/sms/conversations?limit=100")
rows = listing if isinstance(listing, list) else (listing.get("data") or listing.get("conversations") or [])
mask = lambda s: re.sub(r"\d{5,}", lambda m: "***" + m.group(0)[-4:], str(s))
cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=20)
stale = []
print("OPEN CONVERSATIONS on the line:")
for c in rows:
    if not isinstance(c, dict) or str(c.get("agent_number", "")) != AGENT:
        continue
    cid = str(c.get("conversation_id", c.get("id", "")))
    st = str(c.get("status", "?"))
    ts = str(c.get("updated_at", c.get("created_at", "")))
    print("  ...%s status=%s node=%s updated=%s user=%s" % (cid[-6:], st, c.get("current_node_id", "?"), ts[:19], mask(c.get("user_number", "?"))))
    try:
        upd = datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except Exception:
        upd = None
    if st.lower() not in ("completed", "ended", "closed") and upd and upd < cutoff:
        stale.append(cid)
print("STALE_CANDIDATES=%d" % len(stale))
if stale:
    probe = stale[0]
    worked = None
    for method, path, payload in (("POST", "/v1/sms/conversations/%s/end" % probe, {}), ("PATCH", "/v1/sms/conversations/%s" % probe, {"status": "completed"}), ("POST", "/v1/sms/conversations/%s/complete" % probe, {}), ("DELETE", "/v1/sms/conversations/%s" % probe, None)):
        code, body = call(path, method, payload)
        print("TRY %s %s -> %s %s" % (method, path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or "delete", code, mask(str(body))[:100]))
        if code in (200, 204):
            worked = (method, path.replace(probe, "{cid}"), payload)
            break
    if worked:
        method, tmpl, payload = worked
        ended = 1
        for cid in stale[1:]:
            code, _ = call(tmpl.format(cid=cid), method, payload)
            if code in (200, 204):
                ended += 1
        print("ENDED=%d/%d via %s" % (ended, len(stale), method))
    else:
        print("NO_END_ENDPOINT: Bland API exposes no working conversation-end route among the candidates - closure must come from pathway terminals; noting for the goal-loop spec")
print("CLEANUP_DONE")
PY
